main_measure.name: mean next-day excess fall (short-signed return minus coin mean daily return) on case bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess fall on abs(forecast)

decided_by: Mean excess fall above 0 with t >= 2 and a positive slope on abs(forecast): the confirm rule.
reading: Cases are every bar with forecast < 0 (1-bar horizon, so every bar is on the grid), the drift is the coin's mean 1-bar return over all its windows, the day-grouped t sums the deviations per UTC day, the slope is an ordinary least-squares slope required only to be > 0, and the 30-day minimum maps to 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.005429 on the check folds against +0.00904 on every fold
